summary_en: 200,000 shares (3.38% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 15 Jul 2026 at ¥1,031/share (prior day close); upper limit ¥206.2M. Single intraday auction order, results public same-day morning.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-auction trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 14 July 2026, the board of Maruhachi Warehouse resolved to acquire up to 200,000 treasury shares (3.38% of the 5,921,144 shares outstanding excluding treasury as of 30 June 2026) via a single ToSTNeT-3 off-auction order on the morning of 15 July 2026. The purchase price is fixed at ¥1,031 per share (the prior trading day's closing price), for a maximum aggregate outlay of ¥206.2M. The order will be time-limited to the specified auction session. Results are to be disclosed the same morning after trading concludes. The stated reason is to enable flexible capital-policy execution in response to changing business conditions. The company notes that the order may not be fully filled owing to market conditions.
